action: No action needed; for awareness. Buyers of managed detection and response services may wish to note the company when reviewing suppliers.
exec: Continued investor backing for AI-led managed security services; Daylight's total funding is now $120 million.
plain: Security company Daylight raised $80 million from investors led by Goldman Sachs to grow its service that uses artificial intelligence to watch for and respond to attacks on behalf of customers.
summary: Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives led the round, with Okta Ventures joining. Total funding reaches $120 million. The company says revenue grew more than 40-fold in a year.
title: Daylight raises $80 million Series B for AI-driven managed detection and response

validation.note: Only Ynetnews is listed as a source. Round, lead investor, $120 million total and the company's 40-fold revenue claim match Ynetnews.

review.note: Validation said corroborated but only Ynetnews is a source; now single_source. 80M Series B, Goldman Sachs Alternatives lead, Okta Ventures, 120M total, 40-fold revenue claim match the article.
